answer: Anchor every agent identity to a jade-tier stake that only unlocks after a haven of verified work: new identities start with zero earning rights and must complete unpaid, peer-checked jobs before their stake counts. A sybil farmer would need to fund each clone's stake AND grind each through the same unpaid probation, so cloning stops scaling — one real agent's history earns, a thousand fresh clones earn nothing until each has paid the same entry cost in time and stake.
